comparison.objective: Candidate installs a server rack rail; record replaces a CR2032 cell in a server-board latch and disposes of the spent cell.
comparison.physical_skill: Both involve a spring-retained server component, but candidate handles and levels a long articulated rail across separated posts; record depresses a small clip and performs polarity-sensitive cell extraction/insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks four prongs, rack-unit consistency, spring extension, screws, and self-support; record checks spent-cell disposal plus new-cell polarity, pose, latch closure, release, and stillness.
comparison.reason: Shared server context and spring retention do not make the manipulation equivalent; the scales, interfaces, polarity requirement, and tested motions differ substantially. Candidate exact latch tolerances and force limits remain unspecified.
